notes: וְשָׁמַע הַשֹּׁמֵעַ is rendered once as 'whosoever heareth'; the article takes 'whosoever' under rule 41 and the finite verb is the unrepresented occurrence under rule 22, with the competing reading named in the unit note.
The written יִהְיֶה takes 'shall be', so the preposition בְ keeps only 'upon'; rule 49's supplied copula is not in play where a verb stands.
